Evaluate and prioritize investment opportunities, forming clear perspectives and recommendations on where to deploy capital. Lead structuring, negotiation, and execution of transactions, ensuring alignment with firm strategy and risk-return objectives. Partner with operators and leadership on post-close integration and value creation initiatives. Partner with leadership on sourcing strategy and pipeline development, helping maintain a consistent flow of high-quality opportunities. Work closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors throughout diligence and execution. Represent the firm externally with intermediaries, advisors, and within the SMB ecosystem. Proven ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications MBA from a top-tier program. Experience working with or investing in small and medium-sized businesses. Personal connection to small businesses or passion for preserving the American Dream. Experience with lower middle market / SMB acquisitions. Compensation The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Please note that compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, education, skills, and other qualifications specific to the role. $160K - $220K LOCATION Candidates based in Austin, New York City, or the surrounding areas will be expected to commute to and work from our local office. And while we measure our success in deals closed and businesses grown, the real reward is seeing these companies continue to serve their people and their towns, stronger than before. Where else do you get the opportunity to help someone become a CEO, preserve a founder’s life’s work, and strengthen a community, all in the same job? That’s what makes our work both serious and incredibly fulfilling.
